n1.text: Three movable panels instead of one. Placement is the one you use most, so it gets the room. Everything on a panel is ≥ 60 px tall and ≥ 28 px type at 1 m wide — the pinch jitter floor with hand tracking.

n2.text: Rule: a control's shape matches its quantity. Angles get rings and dials, amounts get bars, on/off gets switches. Every bar has nudge chips for precision. Stereo depth is used for state (raised = live, pressed = active), never for decoration.
